BrochureContent.Content:
Lydon Farrell Property are delighted to present an excellent a 4 bedroom semi-detached house which is a A1 - BER Rated home and is well positioned within the recently completed and prestigious Baker Hall. This extra large house was completed in April 2023 and provides a unique opportunity to acquire an exceptionally well fitted out A-rated home within the town centre yet off the Old Dublin Road therefore providing easy access to the M3 Motorway. Baker Hall is a newly established estate where residents can enjoy the convenience of being located close to Navan town centre therefore offering an abundance of amenities all within walking distance.

32 The Mews, Baker Hall is in walk-in condition and occupies a prominent corner position on a cul de sac. The current owners have tastefully decorated the property to a very high standard, ensuring the house has retained its fresh modern interior throughout and is in walk in condition for a new owner and is the first of this house type to come available since the scheme was completed. The accommodation features an entrance hall, spacious open plan kitchen/dining area, utility, a guest WC and a bright living room on the ground floor. The first floor consists of a single bedroom, two double bedrooms, a master ensuite bedroom and a family bathroom.

The exterior of the house is a standout feature of this home and the large low maintenance back garden is ideal for outdoor living and entertaining. The home also benefits from a cobble lock driveway which provides generous car parking spaces to the front. The high level of energy efficiency has been achieved by using a combination of high-performance building materials and efficient heating equipment, this significant benefit impacts positively on average monthly bills throughout the year. It is very rare that such a strong energy rating is achieved and the agents look forward to introducing and explaining the exceptional technology this home has to offer.

Baker Hall is ideally located within walking distance to a host of amenities such as shops, public transport links, schools, Johnstown Shopping Centre and Navan town centre.

A1 - BER rated four bedroom semi-detached house
Situated on a corner site within a cul de sac
Bright open plan kitchen / dining room
Located within walking distance of Navan town centre
Convenient access to the M3
Prestigious location just off the Old Dublin Road
Viewing of this outstanding home is highly recommended.
